mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows that the signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window drops below 0.05.

failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows that the signal fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window drops below 0.05.
